DEL-11.alt_note: `openclaw update --tag <known-good>` is a managed, previewable rollback with compatibility check, and the updater retains the previous package and rolls back automatically when post-install verification fails; additive-only schema policy keeps many changes readable by older builds. Held at 2 because the docs state downgrade does not reverse migrations and rollback is refused once state is newer than the older release can read, so data compatibility across one release is not guaranteed; AI-activated plugin artifacts are removed by uninstall rather than a versioned rollback.
